arxiv-2012-11385.title: Momentum-resolved observation of exciton formation dynamics in monolayer WS 2
arxiv-2012-11385.creator: Robert Wallauer, Raul Perea-Causin, Lasse Münster, Sarah Zajusch, Samuel Brem, Jens Güdde, Katsumi Tanimura, Kai-Qiang Lin, Rupert Huber, Ermin Malic, Ulrich Höfer
arxiv-2012-11385.description: Abstract The dynamics of exciton formation in transition metal dichalcogenides is difficult to measure experimentally, since many momentum-indirect exciton states are not accessible to optical interband spectroscopy. Here, we combine a tuneable pump, high-harmonic probe laser source with a 3D momentum imaging technique to map photoemitted electrons from monolayer WS 2 .

arxiv-2102-05492.title: Optical control of the density and spin spatial profiles of a planar Bose gas
arxiv-2102-05492.creator: Y.-Q. Zou, É. Le Cerf, B. Bakkali-Hassani, C. Maury, G. Chauveau, P.C.M. Castilho, R. Saint-Jalm, S. Nascimbene, J. Dalibard, J. Beugnon
arxiv-2102-05492.description: Abstract We demonstrate the arbitrary control of the density profile of a two-dimensional Bose gas by shaping the optical potential applied to the atoms. We use a digital micromirror device (DMD) directly imaged onto the atomic cloud through a high resolution imaging system.

arxiv-2103-05592.title: One-Sided k k -Orthogonal Matrices Over Finite Semi-Local Rings And Their Codes
arxiv-2103-05592.creator: Virgilio P. Sison
arxiv-2103-05592.description: Abstract Let R R be a finite commutative ring with unity 1 R 1_{R} and k ∈ R k\in R . Properties of one-sided k k -orthogonal n × n n\times n matrices over R R are presented. When k k is idempotent, these matrices form a semigroup structure.

arxiv-2110-09783.title: Spatial-Temporal Transformer for 3D Point Cloud Sequences
arxiv-2110-09783.creator: Yimin Wei, Hao Liu, Tingting Xie, Qiuhong Ke, Yulan Guo
arxiv-2110-09783.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yimin Wei, Hao Liu, Tingting Xie, Qiuhong Ke, Yulan Guo. Effective learning of spatial-temporal information within a point cloud sequence is highly important for many down-stream tasks such as 4D semantic segmentation and 3D action recognition. In this paper, we propose a novel framework named P oint S patial- T emporal T ransformer ( P ​ S ​ T 2 PST^{2} ) to learn spatial-temporal representations from dynamic 3D point cloud sequences.

arxiv-2211-10268.title: Phase transition in the Integrated Density of States of the Anderson model arising from a supersymmetric sigma model Laboratoire AGM, Département de Mathématiques,CY Cergy Paris Université, 2 Av. Adolphe Chauvin, 95302 Cergy-Pontoise, France. E-mail:crojasmo@cyu.fr IRMA, Université de Strasbourg, 7
arxiv-2211-10268.creator: Margherita Disertori, Valentin Rapenne
arxiv-2211-10268.description: Abstract We study the Integrated Density of States (IDS) of the random Schrödinger operator appearing in the study of certain reinforced random processes in connection with a supersymmetric sigma-model. We rely on previous results on the supersymmetric sigma-model to obtain lower and upper bounds on the asymptotic behavior of the IDS near the bottom of the spectrum in all dimension.

arxiv-2310-11241.title: Humanising robot-assisted navigation
arxiv-2310-11241.creator: Placido Falqueto, Alessandro Antonucci, Luigi Palopoli, Daniele Fontanelli
arxiv-2310-11241.description: Abstract Robot-assisted navigation is a perfect example of a class of applications requiring flexible control approaches. When the human is reliable, the robot should concede space to their initiative. When the human makes inappropriate choices the robot controller should kick-in guiding them towards safer paths.

arxiv-2403-04068.title: A Simple Model of Pentaquarks
arxiv-2403-04068.creator: D. Germani, F. Niliani, A.D. Polosa
arxiv-2403-04068.description: Abstract We describe pentaquarks as ‘baryo-charmonia’ with a color octet c ​ c ¯ c\bar{c} core bonded to a color octet three-quark system. Fermi statistics of the light quark cloud allows to describe two pentaquark triplets: a lower one, well supported by experiment, and a higher one with strangeness.

arxiv-2510-02944.title: Improved Search-to-Decision Reduction for Random Local Functions
arxiv-2510-02944.creator: Kel Zin Tan, Prashant Nalini Vasudevan
arxiv-2510-02944.description: Abstract A random local function defined by a d d -ary predicate P P is one where each output bit is computed by applying P P to d d randomly chosen bits of its input. These represent natural distributions of instances for constraint satisfaction problems.

arxiv-2510-25525.title: Multiparameter Lévy white noise theory and applications
arxiv-2510-25525.creator: Olfa Draouil, Rahma Yasmina Moulay Hachemi & Bernt Øksendal
arxiv-2510-25525.description: Abstract We construct a white noise theory and white noise calculus for the (multi-parameter) Lévy sheet and its compensated Poisson random measures. The theory applies to stochastic partial differential equations subject to Lévy noise. 1 1 footnotetext: Department of Mathematics, University of Tunis El Manar, Tunisia Email: olfa.draouil@fst.utm.tn 2 2 footnotetext: Department of Mathematics, University of Saida, Algeria. arxiv-2511-08349.title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Selective State Space Artificial Intelligence
arxiv-2511-08349.creator: Amin Ebrahimi, Farzan Haddadi
arxiv-2511-08349.description: Abstract Hybrid Quantum–Classical (HQC) algorithms constitute one of the most effective paradigms for exploiting the computational advantages of quantum systems in large-scale numerical tasks. By operating in high-dimensional Hilbert spaces, quantum circuits enable exponential speed-ups and provide access to richer representations of cost landscapes compared to purely classical methods.

pmc-11595694.creator: Qili Liu, Lan Yang, Huali Xue, Yang Bi, Qianqian Zhang, Yuanyuan Zong, Xiao Li, Monika Gasecka
pmc-11595694.description: Ambient pH, an important environmental factor, affects the growth, pathogenicity, and mycotoxin production of pathogenic fungus. Fusarium sulphureum is one of the predominant causal agents causing fusarium rot of muskmelon. In this study, we investigated the effects of ambient pH on fusarium rot development and diacetoxyscirpenol (DAS) accumulation in muskmelon infected with F.

pmc-12439519.title: Longitudinal User Engagement with Microinteraction Ecological Momentary Assessment (μEMA)
pmc-12439519.creator: ADITYA PONNADA, SHIRLENE D WANG, JIXIN LI, WEI-LIN WANG, GENEVIEVE F DUNTON, DONALD HEDEKER, STEPHEN S INTILLE
pmc-12439519.description: Microinteraction ecological momentary assessment (μEMA) is a type of EMA that uses single-question prompts on a smartwatch to collect real-world self-reports. Smaller-scale studies show that μEMA yields higher response rates than EMA for up to 4 weeks. In this paper, we evaluated μEMA’s longitudinal engagement in a 12-month study.

pmc-12464180.title: Fabrication and dimensional scaling of SiNW-FET array via AFM-LAO lithography and self-limiting oxidation
pmc-12464180.creator: Nurain Najihah Alias, Muhammad Aniq Shazni Mohammad Haniff, Khatijah Aisha Yaacob
pmc-12464180.description: Silicon nanowires (SiNWs) have emerged as promising candidates for advanced transistor applications due to their exceptional electronic properties, compatibility with standard semiconductor fabrication processes, and scalability toward miniaturized device architectures. In this study, we present a fabrication technique for SiNW-based device using atomic force microscope (AFM) lithography via the local anodic oxidation (LAO) process.

pmc-12597299.title: Phase-dependent iron dysmetabolism in myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury: From mechanisms to therapies
pmc-12597299.creator: Yilin Huang, Shuang Li, Yuanlin Zeng, Zeyu Zhang
pmc-12597299.description: Myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury (MIRI) remains a critical clinical challenge, often worsening myocardial damage after reperfusion therapy for acute myocardial infarction (AMI). Phase-dependent dysregulation of iron homeostasis is critically involved in the pathogenesis of MIRI. Ischemia leads to depletion of the labile iron pool (LIP) and iron accumulation in cardiomyocytes, whereas reperfusion leads to iron overload and oxidative stress.

pmc-12613337.title: Development and validation of PmMAD7 for efficient gene editing in Penaeus monodon
pmc-12613337.creator: Sheng Huang, Falin Zhou, Ziyi Jiang, Song Jiang, Qibin Yang, Lishi Yang, Jianhua Huang, Jianzhi Shi, Yangyang Ding, Erchao Li, Yundong Li
pmc-12613337.description: BackgroundClustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats (CRISPR)-based gene editing has become a promising approach for enhancing traits in aquaculture species. Nevertheless, traditional CRISPR-Cas systems encounter challenges, including significant off-target effects and strict protospacer adjacent motif (PAM) requirements, which constrain their use in crustaceans such as Penaeus monodon.

pmc-13236940.title: The role of salivary lactoferrin as a potential biomarker for periodontal disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13236940.creator: Hoda Tayebi-Hillali, Yago Leira, João Botelho, Vanessa Machado, Carlota Rodrigues, Juan Blanco Carrión, Pedro Diz Dios
pmc-13236940.description: AimTo systematically review and meta-analyse the diagnostic potential of salivary lactoferrin for periodontal disease monitoring.Materials and methodsA comprehensive electronic search was conducted across five databases without time restrictions, up to January 2026. Studies quantifying lactoferrin in saliva or gingival crevicular fluid in individuals with clinically diagnosed periodontal disease were included. Eligible designs were case-control and longitudinal pre-post intervention studies.

pmc-13553993.creator: Thomas Stein, Alexander Rau, Elias Kellner
pmc-13553993.description: eir work addresses an important practical gap, as DRLs for many CT indications are either unavailable, insufficiently specific, or difficult to translate into daily protocol optimization. The results for cerebral CT perfusion (CTP) are especially informative.

pmc-13616818.title: APOE and amyloid‐tau pathology in cognitively unimpaired older adults
pmc-13616818.creator: Carlos Albarrán Morillo, Lukai Zheng, Elham Ghanbarian, Babak Khorsand, Crystal M. Glover, Joshua D. Grill, S. Ahmad Sajjadi, Ali Ezzati
pmc-13616818.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). INTRODUCTIONApolipoprotein E (APOE) genotype shows well‐established dose‐dependent associations with higher amyloid in cognitively unimpaired (CU) adults. In contrast, associations with tau burden and cognition are less well characterized.METHODSWe performed a cross‐sectional analysis of CU participants from the Anti‐Amyloid Treatment in Asymptomatic Alzheimer's Disease (A4), Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), Wisconsin Registry for Alzheimer's Prevention (WRAP), and National Alzheimer's Coordinating Center (NACC) within the harmonized multi‐cohort Alzheimer's Disease Sequencing Project Phenotype Harmonization Consortium (ADSP‐PHC) data.

pmc-13644211.title: Genome-wide association and polygenic risk score analyses of MASLD-related hepatic steatosis severity in a Taiwanese Han population
pmc-13644211.creator: Ting-Yuan Liu, Jai-Sing Yang, Yu-Chia Chen, Shih-Chang Tsai, Yu-Jen Chiu, Chi-Chou Liao, Yen‐Ting Chang, Woei-Cheang Shyu, Long-Bin Jeng, Fuu-Jen Tsai
pmc-13644211.description: BackgroundHepatic steatosis is a highly prevalent metabolic condition and a major contributor to chronic liver disease, particularly in Asian populations. This study was conducted to identify genetic variants associated with the severity of ultrasound-defined hepatic steatosis in a Taiwanese Han population and evaluate the variants’ biological relevance through cross-ancestry meta-analysis and functional validation.
